known_limitations: Linear Euler-Bernoulli only; no P-delta/nonlinear/buckling/code capacity checks.
Viewport renders one case/combination; envelopes are in tables and point inspector.
Straight selected edges only; no automatic member centerline/intersection extraction.
Inactive truss-only rotations are constrained internally; nodal moments require real restraints or rotational springs.
Material presets are editable starting values; wood is not a full orthotropic model.
